items.name: Amendment 1
items.summary: Raise the cap on land a single owner can enroll in the Conservation Use Valuation Assessment (CUVA) program from 2,000 to 4,000 acres.

items.name: Amendment 2
items.summary: Require all probate court judges to be elected in nonpartisan elections.

items.name: Amendment 3
items.summary: Allow the General Assembly to create and dedicate revenue to a Georgia Next Generation 9-1-1 Fund.

runoff.rule: In a general election, a candidate needs a majority (50% + 1) of votes cast. If nobody gets it, the top two finishers go to a runoff.
runoff.details: Polls open 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Early voting for the runoff is shortened by Thanksgiving; counties set exact dates.

recount.rule: No automatic recount. A losing candidate may request one if the margin is 0.5 percentage points or less, in writing, within two business days after certification. Election superintendents may also order a recount before certification if they find a discrepancy.

sources.label: georgia.gov: Election Recount Rules in Georgia
